# Who can get a card

We'll automatically send you a Pensioner Concession Card if you get certain payments from us.

## on this page

- [Eligible payments](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/who-can-get-pensioner-concession-card?context=22006#a1)
- [If you have a Social Security Agreement with New Zealand](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/who-can-get-pensioner-concession-card?context=22006#a2)

You don’t need to apply for a Pensioner Concession Card.

## Eligible payments

We’ll automatically send you a Pensioner Concession Card if you get one of the following payments:

- [Age Pension](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/age-pension)
- [Carer Payment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/carer-payment)
- [Disability Support Pension](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/disability-support-pension)
- [Parenting Payment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/parenting-payment) single.

Your Parenting Payment single ends when your youngest child turns 14. You can keep your card for 12 weeks after your Parenting Payment ends.

### If you're 55 or older

We’ll also automatically send you a Pensioner Concession Card if you’re 55 or older and get one of the following payments for more than 9 months:

- [JobSeeker Payment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/jobseeker-payment)
- [Parenting Payment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/parenting-payment) partnered
- [Special Benefit](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/special-benefit) and you’re an Australian resident.

### If you have a partial capacity to work

We’ll automatically send you a Pensioner Concession Card if you have a partial capacity to work and you're getting any of the following payments:

- [JobSeeker Payment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/jobseeker-payment)
- [Parenting Payment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/parenting-payment) partnered
- [Youth Allowance](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/youth-allowance) as a job seeker.

If you find a job, you may be able to keep your card for a short time.

### If you’re a single principal carer

We’ll automatically send you a Pensioner Concession Card if you’re a single principal carer and getting one of the following payments:

- [Jobseeker Payment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/jobseeker-payment)
- [Youth Allowance](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/youth-allowance) as a job seeker.

## If you have a Social Security Agreement with New Zealand

You can get a Pensioner Concession Card if you get an eligible payment under a Social Security Agreement with New Zealand.

If you don’t automatically get a Pensioner Concession Card, you should call us on your regular [Centrelink payment line](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/phone-us).

[Benefits of the card\\
\\
With a Pensioner Concession Card (PCC) you can get cheaper medicine, bulk billed doctor visits and help with hearing services.](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/benefits-pensioner-concession-card?context=22006)

[Pensioner Concession Card for non-pensioners - 9 October 2017\\
\\
We may have cancelled your pension payment on 1 January 2017 because of changes to the pension assets test.](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/pensioner-concession-card-for-non-pensioners-9-october-2017?context=22006)
